criteria.criterion: Real Tab focus on contact button and phone
criteria.evidence: qa-contact-button-focus-{width}.jpg; qa-contact-phone-focus-{width}.jpg; qa-contact-phone-focus-scrolled-320.jpg; raw :focus-visible=true, solid 2px outline, offset 6px, #f3f2e8 on actual #20473d. sRGB pairwise ratio 9.20:1; not a full WCAG audit. observations.actual: From selected contact H2, Tab to phone at 320×568 places phone bottom at y=568.15: upper and side edges of the light outline are visible; lower edge is outside viewport and becomes visible after ordinary scroll.
